info.name: SMemories - customisation editor (E09)
info.description: Book designs (E09 stage 1, T-141, D-41): `GET /api/book-design/get`, `POST /api/book-design/update`, `POST /api/book-design/reset`, the `design` of `GET /api/book-data/get` and the reset when a book's template changes. `{status,data}` envelope, `ERROR_*` codes. Uses the two verified accounts of notes.postman_collection.json (A owns the books, B is the other user; book-data/get needs a verified email): run that collection's Setup once (or this one's) and then `make verify-newman-users`. Run from the repository root: `newman run postman/customisation-editor.postman_collection.json`. Start the API with SMEM_ENV=dev and the `make up` stack. Each folder creates and deletes its own yearbook, so the collection can run twice in a row; a run makes about 40 design writes (limit 60 per 10 minutes per user, `make reset-limits` clears it), so wait or reset between two runs.
